intro: For a country of under four million people, Croatia has an astonishing sporting record.

chapters.title: Football
text: Croatia reached the World Cup final in 2018 and finished third in 1998 and 2022. Luka Modrić won the Ballon d'Or in 2018.

chapters.title: Tennis, skiing and more
text: Goran Ivanišević won Wimbledon in 2001 as a wildcard ranked 125th. Skier Janica Kostelić won four Olympic golds, and Croatia is strong in handball and water polo.

keyTerms.meaning: A special invitation to enter a tournament without qualifying.
